entries.name: Regular gasoline, average retail price
entries.definition: The average retail price of a gallon of regular-grade gasoline, from EIA's weekly survey of retail stations.
entries.caveat: Published for the nation and a small set of states, not for counties or cities; a county page shows the containing area's price and names it.
entries.intended_use: Show what a gallon of gas costs in the nearest area EIA publishes.
limitations: Published for the nation and a small set of states, not for counties or cities; a county page shows the containing area's price and names it.
Weekly prices are never averaged into an annual figure by this platform.

entries.name: Regular gasoline, average price (Census region)
entries.definition: The average price BLS records for a gallon of unleaded regular gasoline in urban areas of the Census region, collected for the Consumer Price Index.
entries.universe: urban consumers in the Census region
entries.caveat: A regional urban average, not a local price; used only where EIA publishes no state price.
entries.intended_use: Show what a gallon of gas costs where no state price exists.
limitations: A regional urban average, not a local price; used only where EIA publishes no state price.

entries.name: Food at home prices (Consumer Price Index)
entries.definition: The Consumer Price Index for food bought at grocery stores and other stores for eating at home, for all urban consumers in the area, not seasonally adjusted.
entries.universe: all urban consumers in the area
entries.caveat: An index whose level depends on each area's own base, so only its change over a year is meaningful; levels of two areas are never compared.
entries.intended_use: Show how fast grocery prices have changed in the nearest area BLS publishes.
limitations: An index whose level depends on each area's own base, so only its change over a year is meaningful; levels of two areas are never compared.

entries.name: Regional price parity, all items
entries.definition: How the overall price level of goods and services in the area compares with the national average, set at 100.
entries.caveat: A level relative to the nation in one year; it is not a measure of inflation, and parities from different years are on different national bases.
entries.intended_use: Show whether everyday costs in the area run above or below the national average.
limitations: A level relative to the nation in one year; it is not a measure of inflation, and parities from different years are on different national bases.
